title: Reduced elastic P-SV reflection at an Al6061 / steel-like interface
command: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'code');import numpy as np,elastic_psv as ep,json;w=2*np.pi*1e6;A=ep.ElasticISO('Al6061',2700.0,107.6e9,26.5e9);B=ep.ElasticISO('steel',7800.0,281.0e9,82.0e9);rows=[{k:(float(v.real) if isinstance(v,complex) else float(v)) for k,v in ep.solve_psv(A,B,w,t).items() if not isinstance(v,complex) or abs(v.imag)<1e-30} for t in (0,5,15,30,45,60,75,85)];json.dump(rows,open(sys.argv[1],'w'),indent=2)" validation/evidence/EXP-ELASTIC-REF/raw.json

convergence.note: closed-form comparison, not a discretisation; no mesh parameter exists

notes: The only configuration whose energy closure is verified. This is the acceptance oracle any coupled solver must reproduce in the piezo-thermal-decoupled limit.
